request.subject: UNIT:DINOSAUR:SUBMARINE

layers.text: Turn it into a stone-age log submarine: remove the mast, sail and feathers; the open canoe becomes one closed long tree-trunk log of the same tawny wood with dark bark and a flat sawn end with tree rings at the stern; keep the carved blue orange-striped plesiosaur head at the bow; on top a small hatch covered with sandy hide with dark spots and a tall bone-white reed. No legs, no flippers: a log boat. Keep the size, waterline, thick black outline and style, with nothing under the hull.
